definitions.explanation: Placed before a noun, mostly a Sino-Japanese one, to mean big, great or serious: {大問題|だいもんだい} (a big problem), {大成功|だいせいこう} (a great success), {大事件|だいじけん} (a major incident). Also {大|だい}の + noun: a full-grown or thoroughgoing one.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大問題|だいもんだい}だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{甘党|あまとう}→甘党：08339_amatou⟧だ。
examples.english: He has a huge sweet tooth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大成功|だいせいこう}→大成功：03114_daiseikou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The new product was a great success and sold out within a week of going on sale.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The character {大|だい} has three readings as a prefix, and the word decides which:
- だい, mostly before Sino-Japanese nouns: {大問題|だいもんだい}, ⟦{大成功|だいせいこう}→大成功：03114_daiseikou⟧, ⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧
- たい, in some fixed words: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧, ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧, ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧
- おお, mostly before native Japanese words: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧, ⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧, ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a grown or thoroughgoing ~ — {大|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧ (a grown adult), {大|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲良|なかよ}し→仲良し：11449_nakayoshi⟧ (best friends), {大|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ (a huge baseball fan)

COMPOUNDS:
- {大事件|だいじけん}: a major incident
- ⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧: a large corporation
- ⟦{大人気|だいにんき}→大人気：12205_daininki⟧: hugely popular
- ⟦{大失敗|だいしっぱい}→大失敗：17916_daishippai⟧: a big failure
